dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: This was my favorite sight when I first moved to Fontaine. And now, it's one I get to see every day as I walk through the streets.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Here, on these dazzling streets that seem to go on forever, the first corner of the Chiori fashion kingdom has been established.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I will work hard to expand its territory over the coming years. In the meantime, you're always welcome to drop by for a visit.
